# Bolna

Create conversational voice agents using Bolna AI to enhance interactions, streamline operations and automate support.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bolna/.

## Actions

- **Delete agent by id**: Delete an agent
- **Delete batch by id**: Delete a batch
- **Fetch all batches by agent id** (read-only): List all batches for agent
- **Get all agents** (read-only): List all agents
- **Get all phone numbers** (read-only): List all phone numbers for your account
- **Get execution by id** (read-only): Retrieve specific execution by execution id
- **Make a phone call from agent**: Initiate calls
- **Retrieve agent by id** (read-only): Retrieve an agent
- **Retrieve agent execution details** (read-only): Retrieve specific execution by an agent
- **Retrieve agent execution status** (read-only): Retrieve all executions by an agent
- **Retrieve batch details by id** (read-only): Retrieve a batch
- **Retrieve batch execution list** (read-only): Retrieve all executions from a batch
- **Schedule batch by id**: Schedule a batch for calling via agent
- **Setup inbound call for agent**: Add agent for inbound calls
- **Stop batch by id**: Stop a running batch
